name: Craig Handicap Assessment & Reporting Technique
description: 6-subscale measure of participation in community for people with disabilities. Each subscale 0–100; 100 = level of function of non-disabled person.
shirleySays: ICC 0.80–0.96 per subscale. MDC: ~10 pts per subscale. Normed in SCI, TBI, MS, stroke, amputation, and general disability populations. One of the few measures specifically targeting ICF 'Participation' and environmental integration.

scoring.range: 6 subscales (0–100 each; 100 = level of function of non-disabled person)
scoring.mcidNote: ~10 pts per subscale considered clinically meaningful
